info.name: Digital Shop Manager API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection. BEFORE RUNNING:
1. Import environment.json and select 'Digital Shop Manager - Local'
2. Run 'Auth/Login' first — it saves the token automatically
3. All other requests use {{accessToken}} from the environment

exec: pm.test('Has accessToken', function() { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); });
var d = pm.response.json().data; if(d && d.accessToken) pm.environment.set('accessToken', d.accessToken);
pm.test('Duplicate slug is rejected', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('Category summary fields are returned', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.have.all.keys('total', 'active', 'inactive', 'withProducts'); });
pm.test('Category query returns paginated result', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().meta).to.have.property('totalPages'); });
pm.test('Unauthenticated category access is rejected', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Destination category created', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.environment.set('reassignmentCategoryId', pm.response.json().data._id); });
var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('productId', d._id); pm.environment.set('productSku', d.sku);
pm.test('Initial stock and barcode saved', function() { pm.expect(d.stock).to.equal(100); pm.expect(d.barcode).to.equal('012345678905'); });

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Postman Test Headphones",
  "sku": "{{productSku}}",
  "barcode": "012345678905",
  "category": "{{categoryId}}",
  "price": 99.99,
  "cost": 50.00,
  "stock": 100,
  "lowStockThreshold": 10,
  "unit": "pcs",
  "description": "Test product created via Postman",
  "imageUrl": "https://example.com/product.jpg",
  "isActive": true
}

exec: pm.test('Category products endpoint returns created product', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some(function(p) { return p._id === pm.environment.get('productId'); })).to.equal(true); });
pm.test('Category deletion is blocked while products are assigned', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('Duplicate SKU is rejected', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('Status is 200 and SKU matches', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data[0].sku).to.equal(pm.environment.get('productSku')); });

item.name: Filter by category and low stock

exec: pm.test('Every result is low stock', function() { pm.response.json().data.forEach(function(p) { pm.expect(p.stock).to.be.at.most(p.lowStockThreshold); }); });

pm.test('Status is 200 and pagination is applied', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.meta.page).to.equal(1); pm.expect(r.data.length).to.be.at.most(2); });
pm.test('Has stock and barcode fields', function() { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property('stock'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('barcode'); });
pm.test('Status is 200 and stock unchanged', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.stock).to.equal(100); });
pm.test('Manual stock edit is rejected', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test('Negative price is rejected', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test('Authentication is required for writes', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Sale reduced stock by sold quantity', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.stock).to.equal(98); });

item.name: List Sales - Filter by Date Range

exec: pm.test('Purchase increased stock by received quantity', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.stock).to.equal(108); });
pm.test('Has 7 and 30 day chart series', function() { pm.expect(d.salesLast7Days).to.have.length(7); pm.expect(d.salesLast30Days).to.have.length(30); });
pm.test('Has system roles', function() { pm.expect(roles.filter(function(r){ return r.isSystem; })).to.have.length.at.least(3); });
pm.test('Product is soft deactivated', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.isActive).to.equal(false); });
pm.test('Category deleted after explicit reassignment', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.reassignedProducts).to.be.at.least(1); });
